title: Omni-modal decomposition autoencoders learn full-stack wearable disentangled representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.07385v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning disentangled representations is key for general-purpose multi-modal wearable models, yet existing approaches rarely combine classification, disentanglement, fusion, and generation of heterogeneous multi-modal time series in a single model. We introduce Omni-modal Variational Decomposition Autoencoders (OmniDecVAEs), a framework that learns multi-purpose representations from arbitrarily many modalities with a single shared encoder-decoder. OmniDecVAEs extend DecVAEs by learning time-frequency latent subspaces per modality through a multi-view self-supervised decomposition loss and a component-wise conditional decoder. On the omni-modal human activity recognition (HAR) HARWE dataset (up to thirty channels) and the public UCI HAR and WESAD datasets, OmniDecVAEs learn the most disentangled representations for unseen subjects (DCI disentanglement up to 3.0 percentage points (pp) higher). translated_title: 全模态分解自编码器学习全栈式可穿戴解耦表征
translated_abstract: 学习解耦表征是通用多模态可穿戴模型的关键，然而现有方法很少能在单一模型中同时实现异构多模态时间序列的分类、解耦、融合与生成。我们提出了全模态变分分解自编码器（OmniDecVAEs），这是一个通过单一共享编码器-解码器从任意数量模态中学习多用途表征的框架。OmniDecVAEs 在 DecVAEs 的基础上进行扩展，通过多视角自监督分解损失和逐分量条件解码器，为每个模态学习时频潜在子空间。在全模态人体活动识别（HAR）HARWE 数据集（最多三十个通道）以及公开的 UCI HAR 和 WESAD 数据集上，OmniDecVAEs 为未见过的受试者学习到了最解耦的表征（DCI 解耦指标最高提升 3.0 个百分点）。在 HARWE 数据集上，它们改善了受试者相关的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出全模态变分分解自编码器（OmniDecVAEs），利用单一共享编码器-解码器和多视角自监督分解损失，从任意多模态可穿戴时间序列中学习解耦表征，在人体活动识别数据集上实现最高 3.0 个百分点的 DCI 解耦度提升。
en_tdlr: OmniDecVAEs, a framework with a single shared encoder-decoder, learns multi-purpose disentangled representations from arbitrarily many wearable modalities via multi-view self-supervised decomposition loss, achieving up to 3.0 percentage points higher DCI disentanglement on human activity recognition datasets.
